# SiftHub

> > SiftHub is an AI-powered RFP automation and sales enablement platform that helps enterprise sales teams respond to proposals faster and close deals more efficiently.

SiftHub integrates with Salesforce, Slack, and other CRM systems to provide contextual AI search, automated RFP responses, and presales workflow optimization. The platform serves SaaS companies and enterprise sales teams looking to scale their sales operations with AI-native tools.

## Key Topics

- RFP automation
- AI sales agents
- Sales enablement
- Presales automation
- Salesforce integration
- Enterprise sales
- Vendor management
- Sales productivity
- CRM integration
- RFQ responses
- Sales engineering tools
- Revenue operations
- AI-amplified selling
- Proposal automation
- Sales efficiency
